Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection on a green signal when the vehicle was struck on the driver's side by
Driver 2, who entered from a cross street and failed to yield. The collision was a side impact, and the damage to the
struck vehicle lines up with the force and direction of the contact described by both drivers. Driver 1 reported neck
pain and stiffness at the scene and was evaluated by responding medical personnel. The injury reported is consistent
with the kind of forces expected in a crash of this type. A Passenger was also seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time,
and both the passenger and a bystander stated the passenger was present during the collision. Driver 2 gave a
statement that generally agreed with Driver 1's account of how the crash occurred. Scene photographs were taken
and are consistent with the statements obtained. Officers found no indication of prior damage to the struck vehicle.
Driver 1 was confirmed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle at the time of the crash. No citations
were issued at the scene pending further review.
